# Adobe CEP dependency

`CSInterface.js` is the unmodified official CEP 12 file from Adobe-CEP/CEP-Resources.

- Revision: `91824a33f1dd43fa55658e68eb4b07c8879c97c4`
- Source: https://github.com/Adobe-CEP/CEP-Resources/blob/91824a33f1dd43fa55658e68eb4b07c8879c97c4/CEP_12.x/CSInterface.js
- SHA-256: `3c45400984772b88cdf4604b4763a29219f8071fdedb9a1fa19d997349003783`
- Accompanying license: `Adobe-SDK-License.pdf`, copied from the same revision's `License/GenSDK_IHC-en_US-20120323_1224.pdf`.

Builds use this vendored file; they do not download dependencies.
